characters.name: First Fish
characters.description: a small golden fish who is very smart and cautious

characters.name: Second Fish
characters.description: a quick-witted silver fish who knows how to get out of trouble

characters.name: Third Fish
characters.description: a stubborn blue fish who hates change and stays put

scenes.narration: In a calm lake, three fish who were great friends swam together among the gentle reeds.
The first fish overheard a fisherman's conversation about coming back the next day to catch them.

dialogue.speaker: First Fish
dialogue.line: We must leave this lake before tomorrow.

scenes.narration: The second fish replied that he would stay and find a way out if caught.

dialogue.speaker: Second Fish
dialogue.line: I will stay here and find a way out if I'm caught.

scenes.narration: The third fish refused to move, stubborn and afraid of change.

dialogue.speaker: Third Fish
dialogue.line: I do not want to move. I will remain here, and if I have to get caught, I will.

scenes.narration: The next day the fisherman's net swept through the lake and caught the two who stayed.
The second fish cleverly escaped by pretending to be dead.
The third fish did nothing and was caught.
